82' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) was quite harsh and Guillermo Cuadra didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

80' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. Corner kick. Barcelona will have an opportunity.
77' The attendance for today's match is 36194.
76' A dangerous looking corner kick from Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) is cleared to safety by the defence.
76' Orri Oskarsson (Real Sociedad) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball goes out for a corner. Real Sociedad can continue in their attacking effort.
76' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Guillermo Cuadra saw the whole situation.

74' Orri Oskarsson (Real Sociedad) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Barcelona.
73' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.
73' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.

59' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) holds his head in his hands after wasting a promising chance. He latches onto a rebound, creates some space for himself and fires the ball from the edge of the box into the stands. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Real Sociedad.
58' Pedri (Barcelona) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
58' Raphinha (Barcelona) works the corner short.
58' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. Barcelona get a corner.
56' Raphinha (Barcelona) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.

53' Today's referee Guillermo Cuadra rightly decides to book Inigo Martinez (Barcelona) for his harsh tackle.

51' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) blew a promising chance when he got to a rebound just outside the penalty area. He struck it towards the top of the net, but the Inaki Pena pulled off a nice save. Real Sociedad have been awarded a corner kick.

50' What a wasted chance that was! A precise cross into the box finds Pau Cubarsi (Barcelona), whose header flies narrowly wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Real Sociedad.
50' Raphinha (Barcelona) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
50' A cross is whipped into the box by Dani Olmo (Barcelona) and Raphinha controls it well. He lines up the ball, but one of the defenders produces a timely intervention. Now Barcelona have a corner.
49' Guillermo Cuadra couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Luka Sucic (Real Sociedad) and blew his whistle.
49' Pau Cubarsi (Barcelona) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle.

41' The ball possession at the moment is 37:63.
38' The corner from Raphinha (Barcelona) is intercepted by the defence.

38' Marc Casado (Barcelona) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick strike towards the right side of the target that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a goal-line clearance. Barcelona force their opponents to concede a corner.
38' Raphinha (Barcelona) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.

37' Pedri (Barcelona) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Barcelona will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
37' Barcelona enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
33' 1 - 0 Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) receives an accurate low pass inside the box and scores! His shot goes to the bottom right corner, ricocheting in off the post.
31' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.

30' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) goes on a mazy run, skips past two defenders and pulls the trigger in front of the keeper. Inaki Pena makes a great save to stop the effort going low into the middle of the goal.
30' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.

29' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the top of net only for Inaki Pena to dive and make a save. The ball is out of play. Real Sociedad will have a chance to score from a corner.

28' Pau Cubarsi (Barcelona) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Guillermo Cuadra with no other option than to blow for a foul. Real Sociedad are awarded the free kick.
28' Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
26' Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
25' Aihen Munoz (Real Sociedad) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
24' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Barcelona was in an offside position.
23' Pedri (Barcelona) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
20' Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Guillermo Cuadra ignores the protests.
20' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.

19' Pau Cubarsi (Barcelona) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Real Sociedad.

12' Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.

9' One of the players from Barcelona times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
7' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
6' It looks like Jules Kounde (Barcelona) saw red with that tackle. Guillermo Cuadra won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
2' Raphinha (Barcelona) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
2' A cross from Raphinha (Barcelona) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. Barcelona win a corner.
2' Good clearance! Luka Sucic (Real Sociedad) receives a brilliant short pass and finds himself in a good position inside the box, but he's robbed of the ball by one of the defending players.
